headline: Hill Climb Racing: Finland's 1 billion downloads
title: Hill Climb Racing Facts | One Billion Downloads | Classic Games
video_script: Hill Climb Racing is a two D physics racing game from the Finnish studio Fingersoft, released in twenty twelve. You drive Bill Newton up hills using just two buttons, gas and brake, collecting coins and fuel. The game ends if you run out of fuel or break the driver's neck. In twenty eighteen the franchise became the first Finnish mobile game franchise since Angry Birds to reach one billion downloads. Best vehicle? Comment below!
description: Hill Climb Racing (Fingersoft, Finland, 2012) uses two buttons and its franchise reached 1 billion downloads in 2018, the first Finnish mobile franchise since Angry Birds. Source: Wikipedia.
